response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with genuine geospatial depth (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and proven low-latency systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second — but that work was in D, not C++ or Rust. His only professional C/C++ exposure is roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and recent years (Optilyz, RIDE, re:cinq) have been squarely in TypeScript/Node full-stack and AI tooling. The role's core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) for production routing tile pipelines, plus navigation guidance experience — is not demonstrated. He could plausibly ramp given systems-language fluency and stated willingness to work across the stack, but he would be a stretch hire against candidates with current C++ pipeline experience.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including founding an open-source geo-data platform
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching) at ad-tech scale
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, own test tooling, Linux/Docker/Kubernetes
concerns: No modern C++ or Rust experience; last C/C++ role was ~7 months in 2014–2015
Recent 5+ years are TypeScript/Node web and full-stack, not systems data pipelines
No navigation/routing guidance or map-tiling pipeline background
